faqs.question: How can I book a hotel through the website ?
faqs.answer: You can easily book by entering the city or hotel name, check -in and check -out dates, and number of guests, then clicking “Search.” Select your preferred hotel and room, and c omplete the payment to confirm your booking.

faqs.question: Are taxes and tourist fees included in the room rate ?
faqs.answer: Most rates include taxes and fees, but in some destinations, a local or tourist tax may be charged upon check -in.

faqs.question: Can I modify or cancel my h otel booking after confirmation ?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can do so through the “Manage Booking” page. Cancellation policies vary depending on the hotel and room type.

faqs.question: Can I pay at the hotel upon arrival ?
faqs.answer: Some hotels allow payment upon arrival, while others require prepayment to c onfirm the booking. This will be clearly stated during the booking process.

faqs.question: Is breakfast included in the room rate ?
faqs.answer: It depends on the room type and rate plan you choose (roo m only, bed & breakfast, half board, etc.).

faqs.question: How can I find the exact location of the hotel ?
faqs.answer: You can view the hotel’s location on the map shown on the booking page, along with distances from major landmarks and the airport.

faqs.question: Can I book more than one room at the same time ?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can select the number of rooms you need during the sea rch or booking process.

faqs.question: Can I book a hotel for someone else ?
faqs.answer: Yes, as long as you enter the guest’s name exactly as shown on  their ID or passport.

faqs.question: What should I do if I face a problem during check -in?
faqs.answer: Please contact our customer support team or the hotel’s front desk immediately. We’ll assist you in resolving the issue as quickly as possible.

faqs.question: Can I request an extra  bed or special amenities ?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can request an extra bed, baby cot, or special facilities such as an accessible room durin g booking or by contacting the hotel directly.

faqs.question: Can I request early check -in or late check -out?
faqs.answer: This depends on the hotel’s policy and room availability. Additional charges may apply in some cases.

faqs.question: Is Wi -Fi available at the hotel ?
faqs.answer: Most hotels offer free Wi -Fi, but some may charge extra for high -speed internet or access in certain areas.

faqs.question: Can I book a hotel without a credit card ?
faqs.answer: Some hotels allow bookings without a credit card, but most require a valid card to secure your reservation.

faqs.question: What happens if I don’t show up at the hotel ?
faqs.answer: If you fail to cancel your booking in advance and do not check in, a “no -show” fee may be charged according to the hotel’s policy.

faqs.question: Are the hotels family -friendly and safe ?
faqs.answer: Yes, we partner only with verified and secure hotels, and most properties offer family - friendly options and child facilities.

faqs.question: Can I see photos of the hotel and rooms before booking ?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide high -quality photos of the hotel, rooms, and facilities  so you can review them before booking.

faqs.question: Does the room rate include airport transfers ?
faqs.answer: Some hotels offer free or paid airport transfer services. You can check this information in the hotel details section.

faqs.question: Can I book a long -term stay ?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can book a long -term stay, and many hotels offer special rates for extended stays.
